environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9 runtime) deployed behind API Gateway (REST API, no additional request validation). Lambda execution role has ec2:DescribeInstances and s3:GetObject permissions. Function runs in a VPC with NAT gateway for outbound access. IMDSv1 is enabled on the Lambda execution environment. No network policy restricts outbound DNS or HTTP from the Lambda function. API Gateway has no request body validation template.
